# auto-router

> Local LiteLLM gateway exposing auto-free / auto-balanced / auto-smart. A pre-call hook masks secrets and personal data (DLP),
> classifies each request (task, complexity) and a routing engine picks the model from per-profile tables (Gemini, the safety-filtered free
> OmniRoute pool, Claude / ChatGPT / Copilot via CLI bridge or API), setting reasoning effort and falling back on failure.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): map, commands, invariants, gotchas for AI assistants
- [INSTALL_WITH_AI.md](INSTALL_WITH_AI.md): runbook for an AI assistant to install everything on a new computer (any OS)
- [UPDATE_WITH_AI.md](UPDATE_WITH_AI.md): runbook for an AI assistant to update an existing install, keeping keys and choices
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each version
- [docs/INSTALL-LESSONS.md](docs/INSTALL-LESSONS.md): every trap met during the first installation
- [README.md](README.md): overview, status, quick start

## Docs
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): components, request flow, state, failure behaviour
- [docs/ROUTING.md](docs/ROUTING.md): profiles, task types, tables, engine filters, mid-task behaviour, pins, effort, learning
- [docs/GET-KEYS.md](docs/GET-KEYS.md): step-by-step links and instructions for every key and subscription login
- [docs/CONFIGURATION.md](docs/CONFIGURATION.md): env vars and config files
- [docs/CLAUDE-BRIDGE.md](docs/CLAUDE-BRIDGE.md): Claude Code bridge, workspace detection, smooth model switching
- [docs/FREE-TIER-LIMITS.md](docs/FREE-TIER-LIMITS.md): measured free models, limits and latency (2026-10-20)
- [docs/OPERATIONS.md](docs/OPERATIONS.md): run, switch routes, add providers, troubleshooting
- [`ar.mjs logs`](`ar.mjs logs`): readable operation log (route, call, failover events)
- [`ar.mjs usage`](`ar.mjs usage`): on-demand token/usage report (reads data/usage.jsonl)
- [docs/TESTING.md](docs/TESTING.md): unit, smoke, probe tests
- [docs/SECURITY.md](docs/SECURITY.md): safety mode, privacy classes, DLP and its limits, secrets, exposure, permissions, terms of service
- [docs/SECURITY-CHANGES.md](docs/SECURITY-CHANGES.md): what the 0.4.0 hardening changed, what was verified, what is pending, manual steps
- [docs/OMNIROUTE-CONTRACT.md](docs/OMNIROUTE-CONTRACT.md): the only OmniRoute surface the project uses, circuit breaker, safe upgrade
- [docs/DECISIONS.md](docs/DECISIONS.md): rationale and open items
- [docs/VSCODE-SETUP.md](docs/VSCODE-SETUP.md): Copilot Chat wiring (working; key via requestHeaders)

## Code
- [litellm/routing.yaml](litellm/routing.yaml): routing v3 tables (profile → task → band → candidates), aliases, pins
- [litellm/models.yaml](litellm/models.yaml): per-model privacy class, price, fit, limits
- [litellm/config.yaml](litellm/config.yaml): models, fallbacks, timeouts
- [litellm/router_hook.py](litellm/router_hook.py): DLP, classification, calling the engine; [engine.py](litellm/engine.py), [dlp.py](litellm/dlp.py), [safety.py](litellm/safety.py), [pool.py](litellm/pool.py)
- [claude-bridge/server.mjs](claude-bridge/server.mjs): OpenAI-compatible facade over `claude -p`
- [tests/test_router_hook.py](tests/test_router_hook.py): offline unit tests
- [ar.mjs](ar.mjs): installer and control script (doctor, init, up, omniroute, vscode, smoke, logs, usage)
- [scripts/](scripts): probe_gemini.py, flaky_server.py, hook-session-start.mjs
